channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Florida insurance co-pay accumulator policy blocks Port St. Lucie man from cancer drug
item.description: Mark Armstrong of Port St. Lucie cannot continue using a life-changing cancer medication because of his insurer's co-pay accumulator policy.

item.title: Second arrest made in fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Barnes
item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that a second person has been arrested in the fatal shooting of Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Leonard Barnes, 66. item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over 17-story Causeway Cove development proposal
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project on Monday, a proposal that includes five high-rise buildings off Seaway Drive, with the tallest standing 17 stories and 192 feet tall. item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks community support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz of Hobe Sound are asking for community support as Dave undergoes treatment for head and neck cancer, with medical costs reaching nearly $20,000 out of pocket.

item.title: Rising insurance costs emerging as midterm election issue for Florida voters, study finds
item.description: A new study from Insurify found 65% of Florida respondents said rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterms, higher than the national average of 58%.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set as England and Argentina advance to final four
item.description: England beat Norway behind two goals from Jude Bellingham, while Argentina defeated Switzerland in extra time to reach the World Cup semifinals.

item.title: Jannik Sinner wins second straight Wimbledon title, beats Alexander Zverev in four sets
item.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner captured his fifth Grand Slam title and second consecutive Wimbledon championship Sunday, defeating Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4.

item.title: Czech player Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon women's title after wasting five match points
item.description: Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown to defeat Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final Saturday for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November, new renderings show 6,000-seat venue at Walton Road site
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings this week of its 6,000-seat soccer stadium and announced Friday that groundbreaking is anticipated in November. item.title: Florida Democrats point to special-election wins as party seeks to break Republican supermajorities
item.description: Florida Democrats outlined a path Monday to break Republican supermajorities in the state Legislature, pointing to more than 30 local and special-election flips since the 2024 election as evidence that momentum is building ahead of the 2026 midterms. item.title: Rising insurance costs drive Florida voter turnout ahead of 2026 midterms, study finds
item.description: A new study from online insurance marketplace Insurify found that 65% of Florida respondents said rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap with nine road widening projects unfunded
item.description: Martin County will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available, leaving nine identified road widening projects without funding.

item.title: Port St. Lucie couple opposes rezoning of lot behind their home from residential to commercial
item.description: Joseph and Margaret Mucciolo say the Port St. Lucie City Council approved rezoning the lot behind their yard where trees currently stand, despite their months-long opposition.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
